+# Design
+
+## Context
+
+UAR main 3e6af7c4 is merged; its primary checkout also contains unrelated uncommitted work. Native run38534534540 uses isolated exact-source CI checkouts. Only Apple Silicon and Windows x64 are release targets.
+
+## Goals / Non-Goals
+
+Deliver the updated packaged runtime and preserve selected model, BossFang delegation and memory behavior. Other platforms, broader portfolio qualification, architecture changes and new approvals are outside this change.
+
+## Decisions
+
+Reuse the existing native artifact/cache packaging workflow; retain actual source/hash provenance and immutable public records. Root owns version, local application build/operation, installer workflow and website. Native worker owns payload manifests and publication. Serialize local build and metadata publication. Finish production inputs before the local pnpm build:mac:arm64 and normal UI operation. Operate fresh prompt/follow-up/cancellation with the selected configured target and check saved settings and existing shared-memory readiness; retain applicable historical memory evidence rather than launching another approval cycle. Full Mac signing/notarization occurs in release CI.
+
+## Risks / Trade-offs
+
+Native Windows installed operation remains pending unless actually observed. A local operated build and notarized public artifact retain distinct identities. No source changes may consume the other session's dirty UAR work. New MCP pre-approval remains opt-in; no protected tool grant is changed for this release.

+# Proposal
+
+## Why
+
+The operator requested shipping current merged UAR main after the source pointer advanced. Published 2.2.36 payloads remain at b4244aea; selecting a source alone does not update installed software.
+
+## What Changes
+
+- Build and package UAR 3e6af7c4 for Mac ARM64 and Windows x64 using immutable records.
+- Release The Boss 2.2.37 with those actual payloads, complete a local Mac build and packaged operation, sign/notarize the public Mac installer, publish both installers and update the website.
+- Preserve original releases, runtime configuration, other-session work and independent qualification markers.
+
+## Capabilities
+
+No host contract redesign or new host capability. This dependency and release operation opts out of delta specs. The UAR upstream MCP pre-approval capability remains governed by its own configuration contract; this release does not enable broader grants.
+
+## Impact
+
+Source/artifact manifests, package version, bilingual release notes, operation evidence, GitHub release metadata and landing website.

# Proposal

## Why

The operator requested shipping current merged UAR main after the source pointer advanced. Published 2.2.36 payloads remain at b4244aea; selecting a source alone does not update installed software.

## What Changes

- Build and package UAR 3e6af7c4 for Mac ARM64 and Windows x64 using immutable records.
- Release The Boss 2.2.37 with those actual payloads, complete a local Mac build and packaged operation, sign/notarize the public Mac installer, publish both installers and update the website.
- Preserve original releases, runtime configuration, other-session work and independent qualification markers.

## Capabilities

No host contract redesign or new host capability. This dependency and release operation opts out of delta specs. The UAR upstream MCP pre-approval capability remains governed by its own configuration contract; this release does not enable broader grants.

## Impact

Source/artifact manifests, package version, bilingual release notes, operation evidence, GitHub release metadata and landing website.

# Design

## Context

UAR main 3e6af7c4 is merged; its primary checkout also contains unrelated uncommitted work. Native run38534534540 uses isolated exact-source CI checkouts. Only Apple Silicon and Windows x64 are release targets.

## Goals / Non-Goals

Deliver the updated packaged runtime and preserve selected model, BossFang delegation and memory behavior. Other platforms, broader portfolio qualification, architecture changes and new approvals are outside this change.

## Decisions

Reuse the existing native artifact/cache packaging workflow; retain actual source/hash provenance and immutable public records. Root owns version, local application build/operation, installer workflow and website. Native worker owns payload manifests and publication. Serialize local build and metadata publication. Finish production inputs before the local pnpm build:mac:arm64 and normal UI operation. Operate fresh prompt/follow-up/cancellation with the selected configured target and check saved settings and existing shared-memory readiness; retain applicable historical memory evidence rather than launching another approval cycle. Full Mac signing/notarization occurs in release CI.

## Risks / Trade-offs

Native Windows installed operation remains pending unless actually observed. A local operated build and notarized public artifact retain distinct identities. No source changes may consume the other session's dirty UAR work. New MCP pre-approval remains opt-in; no protected tool grant is changed for this release.

# Tasks

## 1. Release inputs

- [ ] 1.1 Finish both native builds, package and publish immutable UAR3e6af7c4 records; import actual hashes and pin selected platforms. Completion evidence: exact source-bound native and package records.
- [ ] 1.2 Prepare unused version2.2.37 and bilingual release notes; commit and push complete application inputs. Completion evidence: frozen main commit and source manifests.

## 2. Completed delivery

- [ ] 2.1 Run pnpm build:mac:arm64, launch the packaged app, complete UAR-backed BossFang prompt/follow-up/cancellation and inspect saved target/service readiness. Record actual source, payload, run and operation evidence.
- [ ] 2.2 Publish notarized Mac ARM64 and Windows x64 installers with immutable checksums, metadata and live website links. Completion evidence: both public manifests, verified downloads and live website.
- [ ] 2.3 Commit and push final evidence; preserve Windows installed acceptance as pending where unavailable. Completion evidence: clean scoped main checkout and truthful release receipt.
